# xyops_config (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "xyops_config" "global" {
  job_universal_actions = jsonencode({
    default  = []
    workflow = []
  })

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `job_universal_actions` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
